annotations.title: Check and recode the start region of a coding sequence (OSTIR)

description: Check how strongly structured the mRNA is around the start codon of an E. coli coding sequence and, when the model predicts that a synonymous recoding of codons 2-11 can open it by a gain it can reliably rank (5-fold or more), return that recoding with the predicted before and after. Scores the original and up to 99 candidate recodings with OSTIR in one request, in a default RBS context unless you supply your own 5' UTR. The protein is identical before and after, only those codons change, and no rare codon is introduced. This is failure avoidance, not maximisation: structure at the start codon is the best-supported synonymous lever on expression in E. coli, but codon content also matters, the model scores initiation only, and the tool makes no claim about what a recoded gene expresses. Rates are on an arbitrary scale and only ratios between them mean anything. Runs ViennaRNA on a shared service and is therefore rate limited (see 429/503). PREDICTED, NOT MEASURED (Spearman ρ = 0.39 on two 5' UTR datasets it was not fitted to). Spearman ρ = 0.39 against measured expression on two 5' UTR datasets it was not fitted to (Gilliot & Gorochowski, Nucleic Acids Res 2024;52(13):e58); reproduced in this repo at ρ = 0.509 on an independent leave-one-context-out split over 194,636 measurements, and at a mean ρ = 0.62 over fifteen further measurement systems it was not fitted to — six species, four reporters, three readouts — on which every learned model tried here scored BELOW it (scripts/rbs-eval) — above the published figure because 65,841 rows of that compilation record no measurement at all (fluorescence mean and s.d. both exactly 0) and are excluded here rather than scored as the weakest expression observed. The widely quoted 53% within 2-fold / 91% within 10-fold are calibration residuals on the fitting set, not held-out validation. Valid for: translation INITIATION only, in E. coli-like Gram-negative hosts (the model is parameterized on the E. coli anti-Shine-Dalgarno sequence). Rankings within one construct context; the absolute value has no units and no meaning.

cds.description: Coding sequence, raw or FASTA, starting at its start codon. Only the first 50 codons are read. DNA (T) and RNA (U) are both accepted; A, C, G, T/U only. Max 10,000 nt.

currentUtr.description: Optional: your 5' UTR, everything upstream of the start codon. Only the last 35 nt reach the model. Omit it for the default context the response describes — a strong ribosome binding site on an unstructured leader, which is an assumption and not a measurement.
